text: ひかれたく　なかったら　そこ　どきやがれ！

structure.jp: ひかれたく　なかったら
structure.en: if you don't want to get run over
get the hell out of there!

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.span: ひかれたく　なかったら
patterns.explanation: The たら ending means 'if'; here it sits on たくない, 'don't want to'. ひかれたく　なかったら = 'if you don't want to get run over'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: The れる ending turns 'do' into 'have it done to you'; ひく is 'run over', and たい adds 'want to'. ひかれたく = 'wanting to get run over'.

patterns.name: 〜やがる
patterns.explanation: やがる added to a verb shows contempt for the person doing it; as an order, やがれ, it is very rude. どきやがれ = 'get the hell out of the way'.
